name: Cardiff University
description:
The University of Cardiff is a leading university located in the vibrant capital of Wales. Built on a rich history of excellence, students benefit from a friendly and welcoming community with expertise from leading academics and lecturers, as well as an exceptional research programme.

The university is the only Russell Group university in Wales and are proud of their long-standing reputation for academic excellence, cutting-edge research, and high student satisfaction. Over 95% of Cardiff graduates enter employment or further study shortly after graduating. 

A Â£600 million investment in their campus allows students to learn in a state-of-the-art environment, amongst both historically-significant and modern buildings. Cardiff is located just 2 hours from London and has all the amenities you would expect in a modern European capital city.

90% of research at Cardiff University is officially world-leading or internationally excellent according to the latest independent assessment of research quality.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Cardiff University, established in 1883, is a leading public research university located in the heart of Cardiff, the capital of Wales. Known for its world-class research and high-quality teaching, Cardiff is a proud member of the prestigious Russell Group of universities.

It has been named Welsh University of the Year in The Times and The Sunday Times Good University Guide 2023. It is also in the top 50 UK universities in the Complete University Guide, The Guardian University Guide, and the top 200 global universities.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value:
There’s always something to get involved in at Cardiff. You can join over 200 student-run societies and clubs, meeting people from all over the world.

The Student Support Centre offers you mental health services, career advice, financial guidance, and more. There are wellness programs and workshops on everything from stress management to mindfulness, so you’re never short of support while you study.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Cardiff University offers you a range of on-campus stay options, from modern halls of residence to shared apartments. Whether you want your own en-suite room or prefer to share with friends, there are plenty of options.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
Cardiff’s main library offers tons of study spaces, access to online resources, and plenty of books, journals, and academic materials to help you out.

Sports
Cardiff University has some great sports facilities. The Cardiff University Sports Centre offers a fully equipped gym, a massive sports hall, and many spaces for badminton, indoor football, and volleyball. Plus, the campus has outdoor pitches, a running track, and tennis courts, when you want to get outside.

You can also join Cardiff’s sports clubs – the Cardiff University Bluebirds – and compete in several inter-university competitions. If you're more into casual fitness, you can join the Active Lifestyle program for fitness classes, swimming sessions, and even personal training.

Laboratory
Cardiff University has cutting-edge labs equipped for scientific fields. Plus, the School of Medicine and School of Biosciences feature many labs for clinical and biological research, giving you plenty of hands-on experience.

Cafeteria
Cardiff has several dining options. From cafés and food courts to snack bars, there are vegan, vegetarian, and international food options available.
